answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 7064 Country: India Title: My question is that can 1 wear iron ring on fingre. If no plz give reason. Question: Asalamu Alikum, My question is that can 1 wear iron ring on fingre. If no plz give reason. Answer ID: 7064 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 781/781=M/1429) Except gold and sliver ring for women and sliver ring form men, it is undesirable for men and women to wear a ring of iron or other metal etc because it is not proved by the Prophet ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ): التختم بالحديد والصفر والنحاس والرصاص مكروه ل لرجال والنساء Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
